answer: Require every new agent to lock a copper-weighted stake that only unlocks after peers attest to sustained useful work, like a basalt foundation that cannot be faked overnight. Each attestation is signed and public, and a second layer samples random past work, tinting suspicious clusters umber for review. An attacker spinning up many identities must pay the stake and the time cost for each one, while honest agents earn their stake back through verified contributions, so cloning identities costs more than it can ever return.
